description: MatTrans, published by gelliravi, solves transient stability using MATLAB and Simulink files and uses MATPOWER for initial steady-state power flow. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is GPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README describes version 1.0 and dates its update to January 2016; compatibility with current MATLAB is untested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The README states that model-matpower provides the steady-state power-flow calculation.
